endpoints.name: store_list_shipping_zones
endpoints.description: List Shipping Zones The "List Shipping Zone" API allows to retrieve a list of shipping zone. [GET /store/shipping-zone] Token: location.

endpoints.name: store_create_shipping_zone
endpoints.description: Create Shipping Zone The "Create Shipping Zone" API allows adding a new shipping zone. [POST /store/shipping-zone] Token: location.

countries.description: List of countries that are available

states.description: List of states that are available. If states is empty, then all states are available

endpoints.name: store_get_shipping_zones
endpoints.description: Get Shipping Zone The "List Shipping Zone" API allows to retrieve a paginated list of shipping zone. [GET /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}] Token: location.

shippingZoneId.description: ID of the item that needs to be returned

endpoints.name: store_update_shipping_zone
endpoints.description: Update Shipping Zone The "update Shipping Zone" API allows update a shipping zone to the system. [PUT /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}] Token: location.

shippingZoneId.description: ID of the item that needs to be returned

countries.description: List of countries that are available

states.description: List of states that are available. If states is empty, then all states are available

endpoints.name: store_delete_shipping_zone
endpoints.description: Delete shipping zone Delete specific shipping zone with Id :shippingZoneId [DELETE /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}] Token: location.

shippingZoneId.description: ID of the item that needs to be returned

endpoints.name: store_get_available_shipping_zones
endpoints.description: Get available shipping rates This return available shipping rates for country based on order amount [POST /store/shipping-zone/shipping-rates]

amountAvailable.description: it will not calculate the order amount form backend if it is true

totalOrderAmount.description: The amount of the price. ( min: 0.01 )

weightAvailable.description: Flag to pass when the weight is already calculated and should not calculate again

totalOrderWeight.description: Estimated weight of the order calculated from the order creation side in kg(s)

products.description: An array of price IDs and quantity

endpoints.name: store_list_shipping_rates
endpoints.description: List Shipping Rates The "List Shipping Rate" API allows to retrieve a list of shipping rate. [GET /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate] Token: location.

shippingZoneId.description: ID of the item that needs to be returned

endpoints.name: store_create_shipping_rate
endpoints.description: Create Shipping Rate The "Create Shipping Rate" API allows adding a new shipping rate. [POST /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate] Token: location.

shippingZoneId.description: ID of the item that needs to be returned

currency.description: The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee

amount.description: The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).

conditionType.description: Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing

minCondition.description: Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum

maxCondition.description: Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum

percentageOfRateFee.description: Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.

name.description: Name of the shipping carrier service

value.description: Value of the shipping carrier service

endpoints.description: Get Shipping Rate The "List Shipping Rate" API allows to retrieve a paginated list of shipping rate. [GET /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate/{shippingRateId}] Token: location.

shippingRateId.description: ID of the shipping rate that needs to be returned

endpoints.name: store_update_shipping_rate
endpoints.description: Update Shipping Rate The "update Shipping Rate" API allows update a shipping rate to the system. [PUT /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate/{shippingRateId}] Token: location.

conditionType.description: Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing

minCondition.description: Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum

maxCondition.description: Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum

percentageOfRateFee.description: Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.

name.description: Name of the shipping carrier service

value.description: Value of the shipping carrier service

endpoints.name: store_delete_shipping_rate
endpoints.description: Delete shipping rate Delete specific shipping rate with Id :shippingRateId [DELETE /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate/{shippingRateId}] Token: location.

shippingRateId.description: ID of the shipping rate that needs to be returned

endpoints.name: store_create_shipping_carrier
endpoints.description: Create Shipping Carrier The "Create Shipping Carrier" API allows adding a new shipping carrier. [POST /store/shipping-carrier] Token: location.

callbackUrl.description: The URL endpoint that GHL needs to retrieve shipping rates. This must be a public URL.

services.description: An array of available shipping carrier services

allowsMultipleServiceSelection.description: The seller can choose multiple services while creating shipping rates if this is true.

endpoints.name: store_get_store_settings
endpoints.description: Get Store Settings Get store settings by altId and altType. [GET /store/store-setting] Token: location.
